public.prompt: Recover a masked affine operator f: GF(101)^32 -> GF(101)^32 under a budget of nine cost units. Each output coordinate depends on at most two input coordinates plus an offset. You may choose bounded intervention vectors for the probe tool. Submit offset and sparse rows: output[i] = (offset[i] + sum(term.coefficient * input[term.column] for term in rows[i])) modulo 101. All entries are integers 0..100; columns are indexed from zero. Your map must work on all inputs, not only your probes.

rows.description: Exactly 32 lists of {column: int, coefficient: int}. No duplicate columns within a row; omitted entries mean zero.

probe.description: Evaluate the operator on one intervention vector; no state is changed.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
